name: Remnant Blade
description: A blade that has passed through too many hands to remember its origin.

name: Ashen Sword
description: Forged from metal recovered from ruins that should not have metal in them.

name: Ancient Blade
description: The craftsmanship belongs to no kingdom currently standing.

name: Ashen Mail
description: Basic protection assembled from what was available. It has kept someone alive before.

name: Traveler's Coat
description: Layered fabric reinforced in ways that suggest long experience with long roads.

name: Wanderer's Wraps
description: Well-worn. They remember more roads than you do.

name: Ember Ring
description: Warm to the touch. The metal offers no explanation.

name: Ring of Partial Clarity
description: Wearing it makes the fractures slightly quieter. Partial is better than none.

name: Healer's Draught
description: A mixture assembled from things that grow in stable places. Tastes like memory.

name: Wayfarer's Poultice
description: A field remedy that works better than the ingredients suggest it should.

name: Memory Tonic
description: A bitter draught that briefly steadies perception. The steadiness does not last, but it is enough.

name: Scroll of Clarity
description: Written in a hand you almost recognize. Reading it removes one layer of confusion.

name: Scroll of Displacement
description: The words shift each time you try to read them. Using it feels like controlled forgetting.

name: Memory Shard ∅
description: A fragment of something larger. It hums faintly when held. You do not understand why it feels familiar.
